parent_objective: design an offtrack/recovery/corridor repair route after M2245 audit
blocked_by: M2245 classifies selected-checkpoint panel as offtrack/recovery/corridor failure
supersedes: direct profile ranking from below-floor diagnostic evidence

public_gates: M2246 must design an offtrack/recovery/corridor repair without executing training or rollout
M2246 must preserve the human-view/no-privileged actor input contract
M2246 must keep collision/clearance as an explicit guardrail
M2246 must keep checkpoint retention as infrastructure but not as the active repair variable
M2246 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input contract
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M2245 outcome audit into a bounded task/reward/corridor repair design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if repair design would require actor input contract changes
stop if repair design hides collision risk while reducing offtrack
stop if design becomes another checkpoint-selection or budget-only loop
fallback_plan: route to collision/clearance repair if guardrail analysis shows offtrack repair would raise collision risk
route to task-curriculum stratification if offtrack modes are not repairable by reward/corridor terms alone
route to branch synthesis if no bounded repair design is defensible
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2245 routes selected-checkpoint outcome localization to offtrack/recovery/corridor repair

training_stage.stage_objective: freeze a repair design that targets offtrack/recovery/corridor failure while preserving collision guardrails
admission_evidence: M2245 selects offtrack/recovery/corridor repair as the next route
allowed_updates: M2246 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: repair design defines concrete task/reward/corridor changes
repair design defines collision and noncompletion guardrails
no training or ranking claim is made

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2246 is a repair design and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2246; no wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-history, or measured execution intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If offtrack repair design cannot preserve collision guardrails, route to task-curriculum stratification instead of lowering comparison or self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: uses M2244/M2245 episode-level outcome evidence to design a repair route rather than repeating aggregate training
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit a current-sim task-quality repair branch before any comparison-ready rerun
must_synthesize_if: M2246 cannot define a bounded offtrack repair
M2246 recommends only more total_steps or checkpoint selection
M2246 would reduce offtrack by accepting higher collision risk

hypothesis: A bounded offtrack/recovery/corridor repair design can address M2244's dominant failure mode more directly than another checkpoint-selection or budget escalation.
success_criteria: repair design preserves actor input contract and matched profile/seed fairness
repair design keeps collision/clearance and max-step noncompletion as guardrails
repair design defines admission criteria for follow-up config materialization or execution
no reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design requires actor input contract changes
design is just another total_steps increase or checkpoint-selection loop
M2246 starts new training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2246 ranks profiles or selects a winner

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design over M2244/M2245 outcome localization artifacts

decision_rule: M2246 passes if it freezes a bounded offtrack/recovery/corridor repair design without training or ranking claims.
